text:
Mira: Hey folks — small heads up, spotted a broken anchor in /kb/runtime/quickstart when following the 'batching' link. It 404s in staging. Anyone owning that page? :eyes:
Sam: @mira I can take a look today. can you paste the failing URL?
Mira: sure: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#batching (staging uses shortlink redirect). copy/paste gives 404
Mira: here's the relevant md snippet I found in repo:
```
[See batching](../runtime/advanced#batching)
```
Sam: looks like the fragment changed to `#batching-and-caching` in latest PR. probably a frontmatter slug drift.
docs-bot: *Link scanner alert* — id: scan-2027-03-15-224 — found 1 dead anchor in /kb/runtime/quickstart
Eli: @sam if you're grabbing it maybe update anchor to the canonical one and add a redirect shortlink? tiny PR + mention in changelog.
Sam: yep — plan: quick sed and PR. will do canary patch against staging.
Izzy: small nit: also check frontmatter `canonical_url` — if that was renamed, the shortlink target can break. sed command I usually run:
```
rg "batching" -n
sed -i 's/#batching/#batching-and-caching/g' content/kb/runtime/quickstart.md
```
Mira: thanks — @sam can you ping once PR is up? will run the smoke check.
Sam: PR opened — 7276543295 — changed anchor + added redirect note in frontmatter, @eli could you review when free? :pray:
Eli: reviewing now. one tiny tweak to the anchor text and lgtm.
Sam: merged to canary. @docs-bot could you re-run the anchor scan on staging?
docs-bot: Re-run scheduled by @sam — job: anchor-scan-quick-7276543305 queued.
docs-bot: Completed — 0 dead anchors detected in /kb/runtime/quickstart on staging.
Mira: :tada: thanks everyone. marking as resolved in my notes.
Sam: will follow up with a small CR ping to update the docs ownership file in case this keeps surfacing.
Izzy: optional: add a tiny integration test that visits anchors for key KB pages — helps catch these earlier.
Mira: filing follow-up ticket in docs backlog. thanks all. :thumbsup:
